title: Conform local runtimes to one lifecycle contract
goal: Exercise discover, load, ready, infer, cancel, unload, and health behavior for supported native and HTTP-managed runtimes; unsupported operations return typed errors and process presence alone cannot establish readiness. Deps (vectors): VC-201-041. Acceptance is tests named vc_201_042_* in the owning crate; write them with the feature.
